step: ripen the Ziger, add blue fenugreek, press into cones
text: The sources disagree on the order and timing (Wikipedia: press, dry; Swiss press: long ripening of the Ziger before grinding).

steps.note: The Ziger is ripened in perforated vats or cloth bags under stones.
Blue fenugreek (Trigonella caerulea), a plant, is added to it.
The ground cheese is stored to dry.

processing.text: The Ziger is ripened 4-12 weeks (Swiss press sources), then ground with fenugreek, salted and stored; Wikipedia gives pressing 6-8 days and drying 2-6 months instead, and the sources disagree on the order.
